```sql
alter table public.projects enable row level security;
alter table public.translators enable row level security;
alter table public.segments enable row level security;

create or replace function public.is_project_translator(p_project_id bigint, p_lang text)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.translators t
    where t.project_id = p_project_id
      and t.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and t.lang = p_lang
      and t.role in ('translator', 'reviewer')
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.is_segment_translator(p_segment_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.segments s
    join public.translators t on t.project_id = s.project_id and t.lang = s.lang
    where s.id = p_segment_id
      and t.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and t.role = 'translator'
      and s.status = 'draft'
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.is_segment_reviewer(p_segment_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.segments s
    join public.translators t on t.project_id = s.project_id and t.lang = s.lang
    where s.id = p_segment_id
      and t.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and t.role = 'reviewer'
      and s.status = 'draft'
  );
$$;

create policy "projects_select_translator"
on public.projects for select to authenticated
using (public.is_project_translator(id, (select auth.jwt() ->> 'lang')));

create policy "translators_select_own"
on public.translators for select to authenticated
using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));

create policy "segments_select_assigned"
on public.segments for select to authenticated
using (public.is_project_translator(project_id, lang));

create policy "segments_update_translator_draft"
on public.segments for update to authenticated
using (status = 'draft' and public.is_segment_translator(id))
with check (status = 'draft' and translated_by = (select auth.uid()));

create policy "segments_update_reviewer_draft"
on public.segments for update to authenticated
using (status = 'draft' and public.is_segment_reviewer(id))
with check (status in ('draft', 'reviewed') and translated_by = (select auth.uid()));
```
